notes: Minimal IPyth interface — getPriceUnsafe (read-only, no fee) + getPriceNoOlderThan (built-in staleness gate). Pyth on Optimism is a single contract; per-asset feeds are addressed by bytes32 priceId, NOT by separate contract addresses. Address verified live on Optimism mainnet 2026-05-02 via eth_getCode (1362-char bytecode). Same canonical CREATE2 deployment as MegaETH and most other EVMs. Reference: https://docs.pyth.network/price-feeds/contract-addresses/evm and https://github.com/pyth-network/pyth-sdk-solidity/blob/main/IPyth.sol
